#22163
INTRO DATE
SEPT 23,2026

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance
be amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 13-L in the area bounded by

West Ainslie Street; North Avondale Avenue; a line 50.05

feet southeast of and parallel to West Ainslie Street as measured
along the easterly right-of-way line of North Lipps Avenue

and perpendicular thereto; and North Lipps Avenue,

to those of a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4841 North Lipps Avenue
